summary: Added pytest-xdist and switched `make test` to `pytest -n auto`. Verified 38 tests pass across 8 parallel workers against both the sqlite fallback and the real compose Postgres (DATABASE_URL pointed at localhost:5432) — pytest-django gives each xdist worker its own database automatically. Consolidated three near-duplicate bootstrap helpers (import+seed+link, and .dogfood.toml parsing) across the existing acceptance test files into tests/acceptance/conftest.py (imported_fixture, acceptance_bootstrap, dogfood_config fixtures). Added test_concurrent_workers.py pinning the actual guarantee (per-worker DB naming on Postgres; process isolation on sqlite in-memory) that makes import_fixture's destructive delete-then-rebuild safe under concurrency. C-B01, C-B02, C-B03, C-B04 are now all complete.
out_of_scope_touch: pyproject.toml/uv.lock (pytest-xdist dev dependency) — no other path exists.
